summary: Robinhood Markets, Inc. filed an 8-K to report the completion of a private offering of $2.2B aggregate principal amount of 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2029, including a $200M greenshoe. The notes are senior unsecured, maturing October 1, 2029, with no regular interest. Conversion is conditional on stock price triggers or a redemption call. This is a routine capital markets transaction—a convertible note issuance for general corporate purposes—not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, or any other event explicitly classified under special situations. The role is issuer, as Robinhood is the entity selling the notes. No deal terms are provided beyond the principal amount and structure.
